mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT notice_post_id FROM tblNoticePost UNION ALL SELECT question_board_id FROM tblQuestionBoard UNION ALL SELECT review_post_id FROM tblReviewBoard UNION ALL SELECT find_board_id FROM tblFindBoard UNION ALL SELECT hotdeal_id FROM tblHotDealPost UNION ALL SELECT routepost_id FROM tblRoutePost ) combined_boards

SELECT seq_id, boardType, title, nickname, regdate, viewCount, commentCount, likeCount FROM ( SELECT combined_boards.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY regdate DESC) AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT notice.notice_post_id AS seq_id, 'tblNotice' AS boardType, -- ★ boardType 수정 notice.notice_header AS title, a.admin_name AS nickname, notice.notice_regdate AS regdate, notice.notice_view_count AS viewCount, 0 AS commentCount, 0 AS likeCount FROM tblNoticePost notice LEFT JOIN tblAdmin a ON notice.admin_id = a.admin_id
UNION ALL
SELECT qb.question_board_id AS seq_id, 'tblQuestionBoard' AS boardType, -- ★ boardType 수정 qb.question_board_title AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, qb.question_board_regdate AS regdate, qb.question_board_view_count AS viewCount, qb.question_board_comment_count AS commentCount, -- ★ DDL 컬럼 사용 qb.question_board_like_count AS likeCount -- ★ DDL 컬럼 사용 FROM tblQuestionBoard qb LEFT JOIN tblUser u ON qb.user_id = u.user_id
UNION ALL
SELECT rb.review_post_id AS seq_id, 'tblReviewBoard' AS boardType, -- ★ boardType 수정 rb.review_board_title AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, rb.review_board_regdate AS regdate, rb.review_board_count AS viewCount, -- ★ DDL 컬럼명 (view_count 아님) (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblReviewComment WHERE review_post_id = rb.review_post_id) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblReviewLike WHERE review_post_id = rb.review_post_id) AS likeCount FROM tblReviewBoard rb LEFT JOIN tblUser u ON rb.user_id = u.user_id
UNION ALL
SELECT fb.find_board_id AS seq_id, 'tblFindBoard' AS boardType, -- ★ boardType 수정 fb.find_board_title AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, fb.find_board_regdate AS regdate, fb.find_board_view_count AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblFindComment WHERE find_board_id = fb.find_board_id) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblFindLikes WHERE find_board_id = fb.find_board_id) AS likeCount FROM tblFindBoard fb LEFT JOIN tblUser u ON fb.user_id = u.user_id
UNION ALL -- 5. 핫딜 (tblHotDealPost) SELECT hd.hotdeal_id AS seq_id, 'tblHotDealPost' AS boardType, hd.hotdeal_title AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, hd.hotdeal_regdate AS regdate, hd.hotdeal_view_count AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblHotDealComment WHERE hotdeal_id = hd.hotdeal_id) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblHotDealLikes WHERE hotdeal_id = hd.hotdeal_id) AS likeCount FROM tblHotDealPost hd LEFT JOIN tblUser u ON hd.user_id = u.user_id
UNION ALL -- 6. 경로 (tblRoutePost) SELECT rp.routepost_id AS seq_id, -- ★ DDL 컬럼명 수정 'tblRoutePost' AS boardType, rp.routepost_title AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, rp.routepost_regdate AS regdate, rp.routepost_view_count AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblRoutePostComment WHERE routepost_id = rp.routepost_id) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblRoutePostLikes WHERE routepost_id = rp.routepost_id) AS likeCount FROM tblRoutePost rp LEFT JOIN tblUser u ON rp.user_id = u.user_id
) combined_boards ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY RNUM
